title: Migrate IFX into a clean workspace root
goal: Create a fresh independent IFX clone and sibling V4 runtime roots under D:/IFX-Root while preserving the existing D:/IFX repository and its linked worktrees as rollback sources.
acceptanceCriteria: D:/IFX-Root/IFX is an independent clean clone of the pushed codex/v4-development-base branch.
The released V4 Guards 1.1.0 assets are hash-verified and installed under D:/IFX-Root/guard-runtime/releases with an external receipt.
TargetRoot, PackageRoot, StateRoot and EvidenceRoot use the documented non-overlapping sibling topology without links or reparse points.
The new clone passes V4 package validation and the current V3 Validate baseline.
The existing D:/IFX repository and all registered linked worktrees remain untouched and available for rollback.
No old-directory deletion, worktree pruning, remote workflow or ruleset activation, IFX cutover or Profile implementation occurs.
